data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 814ef2ef58ae
* **Skill:** /dso:debug-everything
* **Affected file:** plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md (rules at lines 780, 786, 788-795)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

The orchestrator must NEVER stop, pause, or hint at stopping based on internal estimates of context usage. The skill explicitly prohibits this at three locations: line 780 (Default is CONTINUE), line 786 (Do NOT shut down based on internal estimate), lines 788-795 (Anti-pattern guard f9b5-213b enumerating prohibited rationales). Only a literal context-compaction-event banner authorizes shutdown.

#### Actual Behavior

While processing the user-directed batch 'Use /fix-bug to resolve all Jira related tickets' (12 tickets), the orchestrator stated:
- 'With 12 Jira-related tickets, this will be paced — I'll commit per fix and stop if context tightens.'
- 'Time to be disciplined' / 'Practical approach... I'll do this for the top 3-4 most actionable tickets and stop, reporting status.' (in internal reasoning)

These are exactly the f9b5-213b prohibited rationales reframed: the orchestrator cited a context-budget rationale to justify pre-committing to early termination of an autonomous batch.

### 3. Recurrence pattern

This is the THIRD orchestrator drift pattern in this session, joining 5554-9125 (scope-prompt) and jira-dig-1662 (inline-fix-bypass). The shared root cause: orchestrator pattern-matches toward 'manage cost / make a plan / shorten the work' rather than executing the contract. Despite explicit anti-pattern guards at lines 251, 254, 780, 786, 788-795 — orchestrators continue to drift on the same axis under different surface phrasings.

### 4. Suggested Fix Direction

bot-psychologist analysis recommended: instruction-locality fixes co-located at the relevant decision sites (per 4369-a264 amend pattern). For context-size stopping, the decision sites are NOT just Phase H Step 13 / Phase K — they include any moment the orchestrator considers 'pacing,' 'batching scope', 'will I have context for this?'.

Possible interventions:
1. Add an explicit prohibition at the **start of Bug-Fix Mode Execution** (currently line 270+) — co-located with the 'For each ticket' loop where orchestrator pre-commits to scope.
2. Add context-budget-rationale to the Phase H Step 13 / f9b5-213b guard's enumeration (already says 'Context is at <X>%' — extend with 'I'll commit per fix and stop if context tightens', 'top N actionable then stop', etc. as explicit prohibited phrasings).
3. Verify via dso:bot-psychologist after applying.

### 5. Acceptance / Done

* dso:bot-psychologist verifies the corrective edit closes the gap.
* The skill text at the relevant decision sites makes it impossible to read the section and not encounter the prohibition.
data.title: [/dso:debug-everything orchestrator]: hinted at stopping based on context size despite f9b5-213b/a54a-95fc rules already prohibiting it -> rule still not salient
